opendweb webui - plugin commands

Usage:
  opendweb webui webui [--server <string> --token <string> --port <number> --allow-insecure --no-open]
      local management console (sidecar + UI) [note: --token or DWEB_ADMIN_TOKEN is visible to other local processes (shell history, ps, env); prefer the hidden terminal prompt or the browser pairing flow]
